name: cells_real_like
description: Matched by eye to a real widefield plane the user supplied: cells spanning about an eighth of the frame, nearly touching, a wide brightness spread with a few near-saturated cells, heavy out-of-focus haze, and visible grain on that haze. Scaled from the reference by pixel count rather than by microns: cells are ~30 px in diameter with ~10 across the frame, which on the 1 um delivered grid of the other configurations means a 320 px field and 24-32 um cells.
